**Meals:** Breakfast and lunch en route.

blocks.text: Tuesday: Canaima National Park to Ratón Island

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The Word Tuesday heading lists Anatolia Island and the Sapo and Acha waterfalls. It does not title a Tuesday itinerary ending on Ratón Island.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for a charter flight to Canaima National Park. The charter flight is not included in the tour price.

On arrival, you’ll be met, pay the park tax and transfer to the camp. After a welcome cocktail, continue upstream on the Carrao River in motorised curiara canoes towards Mayupa Lagoon and the Arautayma rapids. There is a short walk along one stretch of the route.

As you travel upriver, you’ll see the changing outline of Auyán-tepui. After a light lunch, the boat continues to Devil’s Canyon. On Ratón Island, settle in and, if you like, swim in the river with views of Angel Falls.

Overnight in hammocks.

**Meals:** Breakfast, lunch and dinner.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: Word splits the charter and the Carrao–Ratonsito trip across Days 9 and 10. It has no matching Tuesday programme with a hammock overnight and no matching explicit exclusion of this charter.
